interfaces.name: PoseSourceProvider
interfaces.pre: start() only after selectPoseSource returned ok. onFrame/onError are the only consumers.
interfaces.post: Every frame passed to onFrame satisfies the PoseFrame contract, is sanitized (SEC-1), has strictly increasing timestampMs and frameIndex counting from 0 per start() (REC-3). After stop() returns no callback fires. start() while running stops the previous session first (CON-1).
interfaces.errors: Never throws. permission_denied / camera_error -> onError once, provider stops (FAIL-5). No delivered frame for POSE_STALL_MS while running -> onError('stalled') once per stall (REC-1).

interfaces.name: RawPoseResult + toPoseFrame
interfaces.pre: raw comes only from mediapipeBinding / MediapipePoseView (the binding converts the library's native shape into RawPoseResult).
interfaces.post: Returns sanitizePoseFrame(frame): landmarks 1-10 = {x:0,y:0,z:0,visibility:0}; x,y and visibility clamped to [0,1]; missing visibility -> 0 (fail closed).
interfaces.errors: Returns null (caller increments stats.dropped) when landmarks.length !== 33, any x/y/z/timestamp is non-finite, or imageWidth/imageHeight <= 0 (FAIL-3).

interfaces.name: selectPoseSource / createMockPoseSource / createMediapipePoseSource
interfaces.pre: consentGranted = camera_skeletal_tracking consent exists. liveAllowed = !requiresParent || parental_verified. nativeAvailable = isMediapipeAvailable().
interfaces.post: Order: !consentGranted -> consent_missing; simulate -> mock; !liveAllowed -> parent_locked; !nativeAvailable -> native_unavailable; else mediapipe. Default clock = global setInterval/clearInterval/Date.now.
interfaces.errors: Never returns a mock provider when simulate === false (FAIL-2).

interfaces.name: mediapipeBinding + MediapipePoseView
interfaces.pre: Rendered only when provider.kind === 'mediapipe'. Library API is read from node_modules/expo-mediapipe-pose typings after D2.0; nothing about it is assumed here.
interfaces.post: Each library pose result -> provider.ingest(RawPoseResult); library permission/camera errors -> provider.reportNativeError(...). Pose landmarker only: no face, hand or segmentation outputs enabled; no pixels leave native (SEC-3). Renders null when !active or the module is unavailable.
interfaces.errors: isMediapipeAvailable() returns false, never throws, in Expo Go, Jest and web (FAIL-1).

interfaces.name: createFpsMeter
interfaces.post: Exact 30 FPS synthetic timestamps -> 30 +/- 1 after the first window; 0 after reset.

interfaces.name: SKELETON_BONES + projectSkeleton
interfaces.pre: view = Canvas layout size in px; camera preview uses cover fit.
interfaces.post: Cover fit: s = max(vw/iw, vh/ih), ox = (vw - iw*s)/2, oy = (vh - ih*s)/2, px = (mirrored ? 1 - x : x)*iw*s + ox, py = y*ih*s + oy. Joints with visibility < minVisibility (default 0.5) omitted; a bone is drawn only if both ends are drawn. Indices 0-10 never appear (SEC-2).

interfaces.name: SkeletonOverlay
interfaces.pre: Mounted as a sibling over the camera/stage, StyleSheet.absoluteFill, pointerEvents='none'. No useSkiaFrameProcessor.
interfaces.post: Root View carries testID; size from onLayout; draws only projectSkeleton() output with Skia Canvas/Group/Circle/Line (the primitives the D2.0 jest mock provides). Colors colors.skeletonJoint / colors.skeletonBone, radius sizes.jointDot/2, stroke from an existing borders.* token - tokens only (lint:tokens).
interfaces.errors: frame === null -> renders the empty root (no Canvas children).

interfaces.name: CuePlayer
interfaces.pre: Field names of CUE_AUDIO_MODE verified against node_modules/expo-audio typings; rename to the real names if they differ and note it in the PR.
interfaces.post: Only bundled module sources are ever played - no URLs, no network (ECON-1). One cue at a time, latest wins (CON-4). Pre-warm: each created player plays once at volume 0, pauses, seeks to 0, restores volume 1 (FAIL-9). CachedCue / CUE_AUDIO_MANIFEST untouched (no frozen-type change).
interfaces.errors: Missing source, not prepared, or any player exception -> play() returns false, never throws (FAIL-8).

interfaces.name: planCueClips / renderCueSourcesModule / generate-cue-audio CLI
interfaces.pre: Non-dry run needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_VOICE_CAPTAIN, ELEVENLABS_VOICE_DRILL_SERGEANT, ELEVENLABS_VOICE_HYPE in the local shell (never EXPO_PUBLIC_*).
interfaces.post: --dry-run prints 39 lines, makes no network call, writes nothing. Real run writes assets/audio/cues/<fileName> (mp3_44100_128, model eleven_flash_v2_5) and regenerates cueSources.ts; existing files are skipped unless --force.
interfaces.errors: Missing env var -> exit 2 naming the variable (never its value). Any HTTP error -> exit 1 after listing failed clips; successful clips are kept.

interfaces.name: DebriefRequest / DebriefResponse (wire, contracts.ts v1.1.0)
interfaces.pre: Only numbers, enums, ISO dates and a bounded archetype name cross the wire; no ids, names, free text.
interfaces.post: HTTP: 200 ok | 200 monthly_cap | 200 refused | 400 invalid_request, invalid_source, legacy_prompt_rejected | 401 unauthorized | 405 | 413 body_too_large | 429 rate_limited | 502 llm_error.

interfaces.name: buildDebriefRequest + DebriefTransport v2
interfaces.pre: createVoiceCoach / VoiceCoach signatures unchanged; AppStateContext needs no edit.
interfaces.post: One functions.invoke('voice-debrief', { body: request }) per debrief() - no retries (ECON-6). Maps ok:true -> result.
interfaces.errors: invoke error, ok:false, empty text, or no response within DEBRIEF_TIMEOUT_MS -> rejects; voiceCoach turns every rejection into the template debrief (FAIL-6).

interfaces.name: voiceCore (server logic, Deno-free and import-free)
interfaces.pre: index.ts files only: CORS/method check, JWT -> userId (401 before core), wire Anthropic (claude-haiku-5-5, no temperature/top_p/top_k), ElevenLabs Flash, Storage signed URL, supabase.rpc into deps. DebriefRequestShape/DebriefResponseShape are structural copies of the contracts.ts types (no cross-tree import; parity proven by the round-trip test).
interfaces.post: handleDebrief order: size -> parse -> validate -> reserveChars(400) -> buildServerPrompt -> complete -> truncate(400) -> refund(400 - text.length) -> tts -> 200. Prompt length <= MAX_PROMPT_CHARS by construction.
interfaces.errors: Unknown keys dropped; badges must be unique catalog ids (<= 7); wearables <= 7; archetype.name must match ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]{0,39}$; numbers finite and in plausible ranges; complete() kinds refused/rate_limited/llm_error and empty text -> full refund before responding.

interfaces.name: HTTP voice-debrief (v2) and voice-qa
interfaces.signature:
POST /functions/v1/voice-debrief  body: DebriefRequest  -> DebriefResponse (statuses above)
POST /functions/v1/voice-qa       body: { seconds: integer 0..120 } (0 = read remaining) -> 200 { ok: true, grantedSeconds, remainingSeconds } | 400 | 401 | 413
interfaces.pre: Authorization: Bearer <user JWT>. Secrets only from Deno.env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_VOICE_*, ELEVENLABS_MODEL_ID?, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, QA_CAP_SECONDS? (default 300).
interfaces.post: Deployed by Person B in D2.3. Tier 3 conversation itself is out of scope; voice-qa is the single enforcement point it must call.
interfaces.errors: Any body containing a 'system' or 'user' key -> 400 legacy_prompt_rejected (SEC-5).

interfaces.name: Quota RPCs (supabase/migrations/003_voice_usage_rpc.sql - FROZEN AREA, D2.0 only)
interfaces.signature:
create function public.reserve_debrief_chars(p_user_id uuid, p_chars integer, p_cap integer default 16000) returns date   -- reserved month, or null when the cap would be exceeded
create function public.refund_debrief_chars(p_user_id uuid, p_month date, p_chars integer) returns void
create function public.consume_qa_seconds(p_user_id uuid, p_seconds integer, p_cap_seconds integer default 300) returns table (granted integer, remaining integer)
-- all: language plpgsql security definer set search_path = ''
-- revoke execute on function ... from public, anon, authenticated; grant execute ... to service_role;
interfaces.pre: Month = date_trunc('month', timezone('utc', now()))::date computed in SQL. p_chars must be 1..400, p_seconds clamped to 0..120, p_cap clamped to <= 16000, p_cap_seconds clamped to [300, 600] (matches the 001 CHECK).
interfaces.post: reserve: insert (user, month) on conflict do nothing; single UPDATE ... set debrief_chars_used = debrief_chars_used + p_chars WHERE debrief_chars_used + p_chars <= cap RETURNING month. refund: debrief_chars_used = greatest(0, used - p_chars) on the reserved month. consume: insert on conflict do nothing; select qa_seconds_used for update; granted = least(p_seconds, greatest(0, cap - used)); update; remaining = cap - used - granted. No new table, so the RLS compliance check is unchanged.
interfaces.errors: p_chars outside 1..400 -> raise exception; the edge function never sends such values.

interfaces.name: PitchIqRepository.subscribeToGroup (behaviour only, signature unchanged)
interfaces.signature: subscribeToGroup(groupId: string, onChange: (members: GroupMemberStat[]) => void): () => void;
interfaces.post: Uses .subscribe((status) => ...): on every 'SUBSCRIBED' (first join and each rejoin after CHANNEL_ERROR / TIMED_OUT) re-fetches listGroupMembers and calls onChange (REC-4).
interfaces.errors: Fetch failure after a rejoin is swallowed (next change retries); after unsubscribe no onChange fires and removeChannel is called once.

interfaces.name: useDrillRunner v2 + CombineDrillScreen wiring (wave 2)
interfaces.pre: Existing testIDs and notices keep their text: 'Dev Client build' (native_unavailable) and 'parent verifies' (parent_locked).
interfaces.post: Screen mounts MediapipePoseView only when sourceKind === 'mediapipe'; SkeletonOverlay replaces the View dots; telemetry-fps shows FpsMeter output; pose-source shows MOCK or LIVE; every new snapshot.cue -> cuePlayer.play(cue). AppStateContext owns one CuePlayer (prepare on persona change, AppState listener for REC-2).
interfaces.errors: sourceError -> drill-notice text; never silently swaps sources mid-drill (CON-2).

security: SEC-1 Every PoseFrame that leaves src/services/cv has landmarks 1-10 equal to {x:0,y:0,z:0,visibility:0}; mock frames pass through sanitizePoseFrame too.
SEC-2 projectSkeleton and SkeletonOverlay never output joint indices 0-10 or bones touching them, even for an unsanitized input frame.

SEC-3 expo-mediapipe-pose is referenced only by src/services/cv/mediapipeBinding.ts and src/services/cv/MediapipePoseView.tsx; pose landmarker only (no face/hand/segmentation); no camera pixels or PoseFrames are persisted or sent over the network in Day 2-3; check:compliance stays fully green.
SEC-4 The live (mediapipe) source starts only with camera_skeletal_tracking consent and, for minors needing it, parental_verified; simulate still requires camera consent (Day-1 behaviour).

SEC-5 voice-debrief accepts only DebriefRequest v2; a body with a 'system' or 'user' key gets 400 legacy_prompt_rejected; unknown keys are dropped; the prompt is built only server-side from whitelisted numeric/enum fields plus an archetype name matching ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]{0,39}$.

SEC-6 Strava never reaches a prompt: buildDebriefRequest throws via assertAiSafeSources, and the server rejects any wearables[].source outside {healthkit, health_connect, whoop} with 400 invalid_source before any reserve or LLM call.
SEC-7 RPC user ids come only from the verified JWT, never the body; RPCs are SECURITY DEFINER with search_path '' and EXECUTE granted to service_role only; voice_usage stays client read-only.
SEC-8 No new EXPO_PUBLIC_* variables; ElevenLabs keys are read only by scripts/generate-cue-audio.ts (local shell) and edge functions; the script never prints a key value.
ECON-1 During a drill only bundled Tier 1 cue clips play: CuePlayer accepts module ids only, and nothing in the drill path calls TTS, an LLM, or a streaming voice endpoint.
ECON-2 Debrief text is at most 400 chars (server truncates, client truncates again).

ECON-3 Monthly debrief TTS budget 16 000 chars per user: 400 chars are reserved atomically BEFORE any LLM/TTS call; a refused reservation returns 200 {ok:false, reason:'monthly_cap'} with zero spend; afterwards 400 - text.length is refunded; LLM refusal/error/empty refunds all 400.
ECON-4 Request body <= 8192 bytes (413), server prompt <= 6000 chars, badges <= 7 unique ids, wearables <= 7 records.

ECON-5 Tier 3 Q&A: consume_qa_seconds grants min(requested, cap - used) with cap clamped to [300, 600] s/month (default 300); voice-qa accepts 0..120 s per call; client QaBudget stays clamped to [5, 10] min.
ECON-6 No automatic retries of paid calls: one invoke per debrief(); any failure falls back to the template.
failure: FAIL-1 isMediapipeAvailable() returns false and never throws in Expo Go, Jest and web; the library is required lazily inside try/catch.
FAIL-2 selectPoseSource never substitutes mock frames for a live drill: simulate=false with no native module -> {ok:false, reason:'native_unavailable'} and the existing Dev Client notice.
FAIL-3 toPoseFrame drops (null, stats.dropped++) results with != 33 landmarks, non-finite values or non-positive image size; clamps x, y, visibility to [0,1]; missing visibility -> 0.
FAIL-4 The mediapipe provider drops any result whose timestampMs <= the last delivered timestamp.
FAIL-5 A native permission or camera error calls onError once with permission_denied/camera_error and stops the provider; the runner shows drill-notice; no mock substitution.
FAIL-6 Debrief transport error, timeout (12 s), ok:false or empty text -> template debrief (source 'template', cost 0); zero-key Demo Mode is unchanged.
FAIL-7 voice-debrief TTS failure still returns 200 ok with audioUrl null; the chars stay charged (text.length).
FAIL-8 CuePlayer.play returns false and never throws on a missing source, before prepare(), or on any player exception; the caption still renders.
FAIL-9 prepare() pre-warms each created player once at volume 0 (expo-audio Android first-play silence, #52722).
reconnection: REC-1 Stall: a running provider with no delivered frame for 1500 ms calls onError('stalled') once per stall; the next valid frame clears it; the engine is not reset.
REC-2 AppState background: the runner stops the provider and calls cuePlayer.stopAll(); an active drill is reset (never resumed) with a drill-notice; on 'active' cuePlayer.reassertAudioMode() runs.
REC-3 start() after stop() begins a new stream: frameIndex restarts at 0 and the previous session's callbacks never fire again.

REC-4 Realtime: subscribeToGroup re-fetches members and calls onChange on every SUBSCRIBED status, including rejoins after CHANNEL_ERROR/TIMED_OUT; unsubscribe removes the channel and silences onChange.
concurrency: CON-1 At most one PoseSourceProvider runs and at most one native camera view is mounted; start() while running stops the previous session first. vision-camera is not installed in Day 2-3 (D-5).
CON-2 One drill consumes frames from exactly one provider kind; changing simulate or drill resets the runner first.
CON-3 reserve/refund/consume RPCs are single transactions under the row lock, so concurrent calls never push debrief_chars_used or qa_seconds_used past the cap.
CON-4 CuePlayer plays one cue at a time; play(id) stops the cue that is playing (latest wins).

out_of_scope: react-native-vision-camera install, recording and highlight capture (D6.1; must solve single camera session with expo-mediapipe-pose)
Tier 3 Q&A conversation, its UI and a client-side server ledger (no caller yet; voice-qa is only the enforcement point)
Skia v3 / react-native-skia rename / Graphite, useSkiaFrameProcessor, Skia on web (web gets the View-dot fallback)
Live cost logging per debrief (D4.1), two-device Realtime test (D4.2), threshold calibration (D7.1)
Debrief idempotency table / server-side dedupe (needs another migration)
